issues.description: The problem statement/UML specifies a static method SealSaloon.acceptSupplyDelivery(String, int, int), but the solution implements the delivery functionality as SealSaloon.receiveDelivery(String, int, int). Students following the specification will implement/call acceptSupplyDelivery, while the provided reference uses a different name, which can cause test failures if tests are written against the stated API.
issues.suggestedFix: Rename receiveDelivery(String,int,int) to acceptSupplyDelivery(String,int,int) (keeping it static), or add a static acceptSupplyDelivery(...) method that delegates to receiveDelivery(...).
